name: mode-toggle
title: Mode toggle
description: The way from day to night. One button, pressed at night, drawn eight ways: a disc sliding over a ring, a dot setting below a hairline, a word on a hairline that rolls to the other, the fermata as an eye, a sentence whose last word rolls, midday whose second half the ink falls over, a clock turning from noon to midnight, or one word resetting from Day to Nocturne letter by measured letter.
